column1: # Genetic screen of 613 C. elegans genes (mutants) for PLM mechanosensory axon regrowth 24 h after laser axotomy; genes whose mutants regrow significantly less (promote regrowth) or more (inhibit regrowth) than matched controls

# Kim KW, Tang NH, Piggott CA, et al. 2018. Expanded genetic screening in Caenorhabditis elegans identifies new regulators and an inhibitory role for NAD+ in axon regeneration. eLife 7:e39756. https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.39756

# Source: article Table 1 ("Mutants displaying reduced PLM regrowth") and Table 2 ("Mutants displaying increased PLM regrowth"), read from the Europe PMC full text (https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC6281318/fullTextXML); screened gene list in elife-39756-fig1-data1.xlsx

# Cutoff: the paper's significance (Student's t-test vs controls, *p<0.05, **p<0.01, ***p<0.001); all listed genes kept: 49 reduced (Table 1) and 33 increased (Table 2; the text states 49 and 34); score = normalized regrowth relative to controls; footnote letters removed from names
